title: French-Style Jamaican Pork Roast
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Jamaica with the technique of a French roast.
instructions: Season the pork roast with the jamaican jerk seasoning, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork roast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sweet potatoes, soy sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar to the pot.
Return the pork roast to the pot and make sure it's coated with the sauce.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the pork for 20-25 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
